reviews.author: Matt Fitzsimmons
reviews.text: Great place and staff. Easy to deal with and they went above and beyond what we needed. We will definitely be back if we have any issues in the future

reviews.author: Cheryl Glen
reviews.text: We have just had a leaking window in our UK caravan fixed by Jamie. Excellent job, very professional and his rates are very reasonable. Great to know a good tradesman in this industry and we highly recommend him to anyone wanting caravan work done.

reviews.author: Richard Burridge
reviews.text: After getting quotes for insurance around town from 3 other repair guys for a leaky motorhome I found Jamie at JLC to be head and shoulders above the rest when it came to a thorough assessment and good pricing. He even found some issues that the others had missed, preventing further expensive damage in the future. Top bloke and highly recommended!!!!

reviews.author: John Russell
reviews.text: Great service. Have used them twice. Had a water pump repair, which was done at the workshop and also a repair which was done at my property. Quick responses from emails.Also a creative fix to an issue I had with run off from my awning getting into the extractor fan outlet. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Ange Abel
reviews.text: I visited Jamie with a leaky caravan, I was epically impressed with the whole setup. Communication was outstanding as was his honesty and expertise. Thanks so much!

reviews.author: Terry & Raylene Helm
reviews.text: This company is an excellent example of customer service. Jamie and the team were helpful and carried out the work why quicker than expected finishing with a great result. I have no hesitation in recommending them!

faqs.question: Do I need to come to you for repairs?
faqs.answer: Yes, we carry out all repairs at our workshop to ensure the best possible service. Having all our tools and materials on-site allows us to work more efficiently and maintain strict health and safety standards.

faqs.question: How long will the repair take?
faqs.answer: Timeframes depend on the complexity of the job. We always aim to complete work as efficiently as possible and will provide you with an estimated timeframe when you request your free quote. We also stock a range of common caravan parts and accessories in New Zealand to help speed up repairs where possible.

faqs.question: What makes of caravans do you work on?
faqs.answer: We work on all makes and models from both New Zealand and overseas manufacturers.

faqs.question: I need a small repair job. Can you help?
faqs.answer: Yes, we handle all types of work, big or small. Get in touch with us for a free, no-obligation quote and we’ll be happy to help.

whatWeDo.title: Repairs, upgrades and rebuilds under one roof
paragraphs: At JL Coachbuilders, we specialise in caravan and motorhome repairs, servicing, renovations and custom alterations in Christchurch. From accident damage and general repairs to complete refurbishments and upgrades, our experienced team helps keep your vehicle safe, comfortable and ready for the road.

With more than 80 years of combined coachbuilding experience, our skilled team has the expertise to handle everything from structural repairs and electrical work to interior renovations and custom modifications. Our large purpose-built spray booth also allows us to provide professional panel and paint repairs and refinishing, delivering a quality, factory-style finish.
While caravans and motorhomes are our specialty, we also repair and modify buses, horse floats, trailers, fifth wheels, truck bodies and other specialist vehicles.
From small repairs and routine maintenance to major rebuilds, we provide practical solutions and quality workmanship designed to last.
Looking for trusted caravan or motorhome repairs in Christchurch? Contact JL Coachbuilders on 027 347 0214 for a free, no-obligation quote.

repairsIntro.title: Caravan and motorhome repairs in Christchurch
repairsIntro.body: Need repairs or servicing for your motorhome or caravan? Whether you're looking to install motor movers, upgrade to a new solar system, or carry out general repairs and maintenance, JL Coachbuilders is your trusted RV repair and service specialist in Christchurch.

difference.title: What makes JL Coachbuilders different?
paragraphs: Unlike other repairers who specialise in just one area, or only one brand we can take care of your vehicle from the outside in, no matter where it comes from.
If your caravan or camper has been in an accident, we don't just repair the hole in the side panel, we can repair the damaged bathroom too.
Your classic kiwi built Zephyr caravan needs new exterior body panels? We make them in house.
From structural repairs, fabrication and panel and paint to cabinetry, woodwork, electrical, plumbing and self-containment, we can manage the complete job under one roof.
We work on all makes and models, backed by more than 80 years of combined coachbuilding experience and a large purpose-built spray booth for professional paint and refinishing work.
Two workshops. One team. Complete solutions.
